conflicts.subject: checkout-client-prices
conflicts.detail: B's /api/checkout passes request line_items to Stripe unchanged, so a customer can pay any price they choose
solutions: Build line items on the server from the cart and catalog prices
conflicts.recommended: Server-built line items from the session user's cart and Product.price; the request carries no items or prices

resolution.decision: Rebuild checkout so line items come only from the session user's cart and Product.price_minor; the request carries no items or prices (D04)

conflicts.subject: no-identity-system
conflicts.detail: No source has sign-in: A and B carts have a user_id with no User model, and C's reviews need a customer, but no source shows how users authenticate
solutions: Add one minimal accounts module (email + password, slow hash, server session in an http-only cookie)
Use an external identity provider the user chooses
conflicts.recommended: One minimal accounts module (customer and shop-owner roles) built new for the unified app; it is platform, not a source feature

resolution.decision: Add a new accounts module: email + password (argon2id), server session in an http-only secure cookie, roles customer and owner, one permission check (D05)

conflicts.subject: purchase-confirmation
conflicts.detail: C shows reviews only after a confirmed purchase, but B keeps no order and never confirms payment (no webhook)
solutions: Add an Order entity marked paid by a verified Stripe webhook; the review gate reads it
conflicts.recommended: Order (pending -> paid) written at checkout and confirmed by a signature-verified Stripe webhook; reviews require a paid order containing the product

resolution.decision: Add Order/OrderItem; checkout writes a pending Order; a signature-verified Stripe webhook marks it paid; the review gate needs a paid order containing the product (D04, D08)

conflicts.subject: cartitem-quantity
conflicts.detail: B stores CartItem.quantity as text; A (and any sensible cart) types it as Integer. Unvalidated text quantities can be non-numeric or negative
solutions: Integer quantity with a positive check on the server
Keep text and parse it on every read
conflicts.recommended: Integer quantity >= 1, checked on the server; B's existing cart rows are not migrated (see migration plan)

resolution.decision: CartItem.quantity is integer with a CHECK quantity >= 1, validated on the server; B's text quantities are not migrated (D06)

conflicts.subject: cartitem-product-id
conflicts.detail: B stores CartItem.productId as a String with no Product model; the kept catalog is A's, whose Product.id is Integer. B's cart rows cannot point at A's products without conversion
solutions: Integer product_id with a real foreign key to products.id (A's keys kept)
Re-key A's products to uuid strings to match B
conflicts.recommended: Integer product_id foreign key to products.id; A's catalog keeps its ids; B's text product ids are not carried over

resolution.decision: CartItem.product_id is an integer foreign key to products.id (A's keys kept); B's text product ids are not carried over (D02, D06)

conflicts.subject: backend-framework
solutions: Choose one framework for this layer and rebuild the others' features in it
Run them side by side only as a short, planned migration
conflicts.recommended: One backend framework; Express is used by the most sources

resolution.decision: Flask (Python) is the one backend framework; NodeCart's Express endpoints are rebuilt in Flask. The script's 'Express is used by the most sources' is a 1-1 tie, so the choice follows where the adapted code and durable data are (D01)

conflicts.subject: data-layer
solutions: Choose one framework for this layer and rebuild the others' features in it
Run them side by side only as a short, planned migration
conflicts.recommended: One data layer; Prisma is used by the most sources

resolution.decision: SQLAlchemy is the one data layer; Prisma is not used (D01, D02)

conflicts.subject: reviews-path
conflicts.detail: Reviewly documents /v2/products/{productId}/reviews; A and B use unversioned /api/... paths
conflicts.recommended: Unversioned /api/products/{id}/reviews; Reviewly's path is not copied

resolution.decision: Unversioned /api/products/{id}/reviews; Reviewly's /v2 path is not copied (D07)

conflicts.subject: fields
conflicts.detail: Field naming styles differ (camelCase: B; snake_case: C)
solutions: Pick one naming style for tables and fields and map the others
conflicts.recommended: Use one style (snake_case is usual for SQL)

resolution.decision: snake_case for every table and field; B's camelCase names map through compat/aliases.json
